items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: We had a boy named Faso, he the first one I see them brushes.

ctx.x: Trump's kind of blues he used to do, cause of blues. But the band had to play real soft on them you know. We had a boy named Faso, he the first one I see them brushes. And he had a big old quilt like in front of his drum. You know he could raise it up and let it down. When he was soft like that he let it down just cause he liked my foot.
What did Faso hit? Did he just hit the snare or did he hit the other stuff? I mean on the soft numbers?
